title: Wyoming DFS Rules, POWER, Chapter 1: Personal Opportunities with Employment Responsibilities
landing_url: https://rules.wyo.gov/Search.aspx?mode=7 (agency Family Services, Dept. of (049); program Personal Opportunities w/ Employment Responsibilities)
what_it_sets: POWER eligibility, $5,000 asset limit, shelter qualified / shelter disqualified maximum payment, $600 / $1,200 earned income disregards, maximum payment test, earned income incentive (50% of the maximum payment), 5-year limit, sanctions, asset and income treatment tables (ss 12-13). The dollar maximum payment table itself is not in the rule (W.S. 42-2-103(e)(iii): 2008 table, adjusted annually for the Wyoming cost-of-living index).
converter: Word-exported HTML to text (one-off scripts wyrules_h2t.py / wyrules_deposit.py kept outside commons)
terms: rules.wyo.gov (Wyoming Secretary of State) states no terms of use, licence or copyright claim on the pages read (home page, Search.aspx?mode=7, Help/Public/index.html); sos.wyo.gov links only a privacy policy hosted by the Attorney General. The site itself quotes Doidge v. State Board of Charities and Reform, 789 P.2d 880, 883 (Wyo. 1990): rules adopted under statutory authority 'have the force and effect of law'. Rules with the force of law are government edicts and carry no copyright (Georgia v. Public.Resource.Org, 2020).
